premises: Cryo-rolling to ~90% reduction refines lamellar spacing and grain size in AlCoCrFeNi2.1 EHEA.
Brief annealing at 450°C for 10 min preserves or enhances the refined microstructure without coarsening.
Refined lamellar spacing and grain size reduce dislocation pile-ups at phase boundaries.
Reduced pile-ups promote uniform plastic strain distribution and back-stress hardening, delaying microcracking.
This microstructural refinement yields ~10–20% higher strength and ~20–30% higher ductility at room temperature.
